besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses joined by 'en'.
besluite.rede: 'Jou nee tel ook' and 'jy mag jouself wees' each have their own subject and verb, so the AWS comma belongs before 'en'.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma; 'vraag en veilig' briefly reads as a list.
besluite.rede: Two full clauses joined by 'en'; the comma is required and removes the stumble.

besluite.fout: 'Hierdie vraag' is separated from the question it refers to by an intervening sentence, so the reference is loose.
besluite.rede: 'Die tweede vraag' points unambiguously to the safe/unsafe question named second, without changing what is said.

besluite.fout: 'iemand vra dat jy ... wegsteek' is stiff where Afrikaans naturally says 'iemand vra jou om ... weg te steek'.
besluite.rede: Same person, same request, same danger sign; the protected 'n geheim vir altyd' stays and the sentence now matches the glossary wording.

besluite.fout: 'al sê hy hy ken jou ouers' stumbles on the doubled 'hy'.
besluite.rede: A 'dat' clause reads smoothly and says exactly the same thing; the protected 'al vra hy jou om hulp' is untouched.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en jy hoef', which starts a new clause with its own subject and verb.
besluite.rede: Punctuation only; the instruction's words and order are unchanged.

besluite.fout: Word order error: the coordinated clause still falls under 'As', so the verb must stand at the end.
besluite.rede: 'niemand wat jy ken naby is nie' is the correct subordinate order and the condition means exactly the same.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses joined by 'en'.
besluite.rede: Each clause has its own subject and verb; punctuation only.

besluite.fout: The embedded relative clause runs straight into the main verb ('kyk daarvan weet'), which makes a reader stumble.
besluite.rede: A comma after the embedded relative clause is standard Afrikaans punctuation and the words are unchanged.

besluite.fout: Without 'ook al' the clause does not carry its concessive meaning and reads as a fragment.
besluite.rede: 'hoe lief jy ook al vir daardie mens is' states the intended 'no matter how much you love them' without adding anything.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses joined by 'en'.
besluite.rede: The comma sits after the protected 'Dit is nooit jou skuld nie' and leaves it intact; punctuation only.

besluite.fout: 'by die ander' on its own reads as unfinished and could be taken as 'the others'.
besluite.rede: 'die ander mens' completes the phrase and matches the lesson's own definition of a relationship between you and another person.

besluite.fout: 'vir wie jy kan sê' leaves 'sê' without its object and reads elliptically.
besluite.rede: Adding 'dit' completes the clause without changing who is told or when.
